answer: Census bond: each identity files one claim in the lagoon registry and pays a filing fee. The k-th claim from one sponsor costs 38+8(k-1) credits, and a velvet seal marks each verified entry. A horizon rule expires claims unrenewed after 12 epochs, forcing re-filing with proof of work. Copied or rented claims burn the 70-credit bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 4,034,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 38 once.
